command: bash -c set -e; P=9b8a922; T=$(mktemp -d); git worktree add -q $T/wt $P; mkdir $T/b; javac -nowarn -encoding UTF-8 -d $T/b $(find $T/wt/src -name "*.java") 2>/dev/null; javac -nowarn -encoding UTF-8 -cp $T/b -d $T/b src/verify/MinerCounters.java; n=0; same=0; for db in SIGN LEVIATHAN TAFENG BIBLE BMS1 C8T1S5I8N5K KOSARAK FIFA; do for sc in init whole; do if [ $db = BMS1 -o $db = FIFA ] && [ $sc = whole ]; then continue; fi; a=$(java -Xmx24g -Xss64m -cp $T/b verify.MinerCounters $db $sc); b=$(java -Xmx24g -Xss64m -Dadapt.iip=off -cp build-iip verify.MinerCounters $db $sc); n=$((n+1)); echo "commit $P   : $a"; echo "adapt.iip=off: $b"; [ "$a" = "$b" ] && same=$((same+1)); done; done; git worktree remove --force $T/wt; echo "identical lines: $same of $n"; [ $same -eq $n ]
role: development machine: counters only, no timings
